content.title: National Burrito Day Deals 2026: Where to Find Free Burritos and Deals
content.text: Burrito lovers across the country celebrate National Burrito Day with freebies and discounts from their favorite burrito makers. From top national chains like Moe's Southwest Grill and Qdoba, to local favorites like Chronic Tacos and El Pollo Loco, you’ve got lots of options for getting your burrito fix on the cheap. Whether your go-to is a classic bean and cheese burrito or a loaded carne asada burrito, National Burrito Day has deals ranging from freebies with purchase to discounted entrees. And if you're looking for other food deals, we have those too: Monday food deals, Tuesday food deals, and Friday food deals, plus more. Download the FREE KCL App What's on this page: What Is National Burrito Day? The Next One Is April 2 National Burrito Day Deals 2026 Offers, prices, savings, and local participation may vary. National Burrito Day is a 1-day event with free and cheap burritos. On National Burrito Day, restaurants across the country roll out deals on everyone's favorite handheld meal. From chains like Qdoba to local favorites such as El Pollo Loco, there's something for every burrito lover. Whether it's free burrito giveaways, BOGO offers, or hefty discounts, there are a lot of National Burrito Day deals. The next National Burrito Day is Thursday, April 2, 2026. National Burrito Day is on the first Thursday in April, and in 2026 that’s Thursday, April 2. Although the word burrito directly translates to “little donkey,” it’s said that they were named after the bundles that appear on donkeys’ bedrolls. Confirmed Baja Fresh Mexican Grill: For National Burrito Day in 2026, you get $5 Baja burritos with chicken at Baja Fresh. Limit one per person. Offer valid in-store only. Rewards members who make a National Burrito Day purchase will receive a $5 off $20 offer in your rewards account. Bubbakoo's Burritos: Rewards members can enjoy BOGO burritos this National Burrito Day at Bubbakoo's Burritos when you use promo code BURRITODAY during online or in-app checkout. Offer valid April 1 - 2. Chipotle: In 2026, Chipotle is celebrating National Burrito Day with a $2,000,000 BOGO Burritos giveaway for rewards members. The game runs from 9 a.m. - 9 p.m. ET each day, March 30 through April 1. Here are the rules for this year: to play, you must visit UnlockBurritoToday.com. Once there, you need to guess the correct burrito combination to unlock the Burrito Vault. Heads up — the burrito combination changes every hour. The first person to unlock the Burrito Vault each hour will walk away with a year's worth of FREE burritos. Then the next 3,600 people to unlock the vault will win a BOGO entree reward. This year, Chipotle will also have a random Double Protein Hour each day where the number of prizes and protein are doubled. The first two players to unlock the vault will win free double protein burritos for a year, then the next 7,200 winners will get a BOGO double protein burritos reward, and finally 4,000 double protein rewards will be awarded. Chipotle: Enjoy free delivery on National Burrito Day orders of $10 or more at Chipotle when you order online or in-app. Chronic Tacos: This year, Chronic Tacos is offering loyalty members BOGO free burritos (excluding the California Burrito and Surf & Turf Burrito) through the Chronic Tacos app. Offer valid on April 2 only. Dog Haus: Rewards members who redeem a $3 Haus Burrito (all $3 will go to No Kid Hungry) on National Burrito Day will get a BOGO reward for Dog Haus' Bad-Ass Breakfast Burritos that you can redeem any time through April 30. Farmer Boys: Farmer Boys VIF (Very Important Farmers) members can celebrate National Burrito Day with an in-app exclusive BOGO 50% off deal on any breakfast burrito on April 2. Freebirds World Burrito: Celebrate National Burrito Day this year with $5.95 Freebird-size burritos when you order in-store at Freebirds World Burrito. Rewards members can order up to 2 Freebird-size burritos online when you enter promo code FREEBIRDS at checkout. Offers valid on April 2 only. Hot Head Burritos: Hot Head Burritos is offering rewards members a BOGO burritos deal when you order online or in-app on National Burrito Day. Jason's Deli: From March 30 - April 6, Jason's Deli Rewards members can save $5 on any purchase of $20 or more. If you dine in, you'll also receive an Easter bounceback reward with perks like 50 bonus points or a BOGO entree. Margaritas Mexican Restaurant: Save $2 on all burritos at Margaritas Mexican Restaurant on National Burrito Day. Moe's Southwest Grill: Rewards members can score a National Burrito Day BOGO deal on burritos, bowls, or Moe Value Meals at Moe's Southwest Grill. Single use. Offer valid on April 2. Qdoba: On National Burrito Day, new and existing Qdoba Rewards members can enjoy a free burrito or bowl with the purchase of an entree and drink. Offer valid online, in-app, and in-store. Surcheros: This year, loyalty members get an exclusive BOGO 50% off burritos deal (that includes free chips and salsa) at Surcheros on National Burrito Day. Taco John's: Taco John's is offering rewards members a FREE bean burrito with any $3 purchase. Offer valid online, in-app, or in-store (scan in-app QR code). Tocaya: Enjoy a free half order of chips and guac with a purchase of any burrito at Tocaya on National Burrito Day, April 2, 2026. Predicted Barberitos: We predict a BOGO 50% off deal on ANY size burritos at Barberitos on National Burrito Day this year. Del Taco: To celebrate National Burrito Day in 2026, Del Yeah Rewards members will likely get a free burrito with a purchase at Del Taco. El Pollo Loco: In 2026, watch for El Pollo Loco to offer rewards members a BOGO deal for National Burrito Day. Kum & Go: K&G's rewards members can expect 50% off all burritos at Kum & Go on National Burrito Day 2026. Maverik — Adventure's First Stop: In 2026, Maverik will likely offer rewards members 50% off all burritos on April 2. Nitro cardholders can enjoy a free burrito on National Burrito Day. Rubio's: Look for Rubio's to offer a discount on burritos when you order online or in-app and use a promo code at checkout. Taco Bell: On National Burrito Day 2026, we predict Taco Bell will offer rewards members a discount on burritos when they make an in-app purchase. Plus, you can look forward to BOGO Beefy 5-Layer Burritos when you order through DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Grubhub. Tijuana Flats: This year, on Thursday, April 2, you can grab a discounted Tijuana Burrito with chips at Tijuana Flats. Plus, you can “Make It Wet” for free by upgrading your burrito with gold queso, queso blanco, or spicy chipotle sauce.
